findings.evidence: In this commit, `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/plan_clone_generated.go:374` unconditionally does `cloned.TablePlans = FlattenPushDownPlan(cloned.TablePlan)` inside `(*PhysicalIndexMergeReader).CloneForPlanCache`, but `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_indexmerge_reader.go:71` shows `TablePlan` can be nil (Init has an `else` branch for `p.TablePlan == nil`). `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_utils.go:64` (`FlattenPushDownPlan`) calls `FlattenTreePlan(p, ...)` which immediately dereferences `p.Children()` (`physical_utils.go:55`), so `FlattenPushDownPlan(nil)` panics.
findings.fix:
Make `PhysicalIndexMergeReader.CloneForPlanCache` robust to `TablePlan == nil`:
- Either return `(nil, false)` when `op.TablePlan == nil` (if such plans are not intended to be cacheable/executable), or
- Guard the flatten: `if cloned.TablePlan != nil { cloned.TablePlans = FlattenPushDownPlan(cloned.TablePlan) } else { cloned.TablePlans = nil }`.
Also update `pkg/planner/core/generator/plan_cache/plan_clone_generator.go` special-casing for `physicalop.PhysicalIndexMergeReader.TablePlans` to emit the same guard, then regenerate `plan_clone_generated.go`.
findings.impact: A plan-cache hit that attempts to clone an `IndexMergeReader` with `TablePlan == nil` will panic (nil deref) during cloning, potentially crashing the session/query path and effectively breaking plan cache for such statements.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on `upstream/master`: it still does `cloned.TablePlans = FlattenListPushDownPlan(cloned.TablePlan)` unconditionally (`upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/plan_clone_generated.go:389`), while `TablePlan` is explicitly documented as nullable (`upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_indexmerge_reader.go:52-54`), and `FlattenListPushDownPlan` still dereferences `plan.Children()` without a nil check (`upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_utils.go:63-66`).
findings.verify:
- Add a unit test that constructs a `physicalop.PhysicalIndexMergeReader` with `TablePlan == nil` and calls `CloneForPlanCache`; it should not panic and should either return `ok=false` or a clone with `TablePlans == nil`.
- (Integration) Ensure a plan-cache hit path involving `PhysicalIndexMergeReader` cannot crash even if `TablePlan` ends up nil due to planner changes.
findings.what: `PhysicalIndexMergeReader.CloneForPlanCache` can panic by flattening a nil `TablePlan` (nil-deref in `FlattenPushDownPlan`), despite `PhysicalIndexMergeReader` having code paths where `TablePlan` may be nil.

subject: planner: re-enable the plan cache generator and move Delete/Inset/Update into physicalop (#63443)
summary: This commit is a large planner/executor refactor: moves DML physical plans (Insert/Update/Delete) into `physicalop` and re-enables generated `CloneForPlanCache` implementations for many physical operators. One High-severity correctness risk remains: `PhysicalIndexMergeReader.CloneForPlanCache` can panic when `TablePlan` is nil, and this is still present on `upstream/master`.
